ratings_why.fun: Two growth paths (Patient permanent stats, Spring fight bursts) that merge at Mabyn give a clear early-to-late shape, though the first turns lean on one Money Spider.
ratings_why.distinct: A hidden board in the preview, wake-ups triggered by neighbours dying, and Lurk handed to other tribes play unlike any of today's tribes; Ooze Bellies are the nearest cousin.

verdict_why: The v3 rules read cleanly and nothing has a loop without counterplay; what's left is numbers and sims, which the owner handles.

points.text: Early tempo is thin: only the Money Spider wins Tier 1-2 fights on its own. A shown Tier 1-2 body that gains stats when a Lurker beside it Springs would give the Ambush something to draft from turn 2.
Patient growth only pays on win streaks, so a losing player's Lurkers stall until Mabyn arrives. Reader of the Minutes could give a smaller amount to Lurkers that Sprang, so a losing run still grows.

The Worshipful Master's rules now work, but the card is a paragraph. Moving the 'passes over it' and summon-placement lines into the Lurk keyword or reminder text would make the Lid easier to read mid-fight.
Signora Corkhinge against the Master is a good tension. A line on the Master that rewards each reclosed Lid (say, it repeats an extra effect) would make the pairing a choice rather than a clash.

standouts.why: Signora Corkhinge reclosing Lids lets the same knocks fire twice; it defines the Tier 5 direction and fits the seed.
Grand Tyler Mabyn is a real capstone: she merges the two builds and gives the late game its permanent growth.
Wafer-Lid Sentry turns an enemy attack into an ambush, the seed's sudden strike in one card.

weakest.why: Inner Guard just wakes a Lurker at the start, which spends the ambush before any knock; it mostly matters in off-label combos.
Lodge Initiate is a below-body Tier 2 whose only job is handing out Lurk, which the Tailor and Past Master also do.
Ballooning Money Spider is a plain deathrattle body; fine as fodder, but it carries all the early tempo alone.

flags.note: An all-Lurker board Springs everything at Start of Combat; with Dew Gallery Orbweaver that is a volley of double-damage Cleave hits before the enemy moves.
Signora Corkhinge plus Orbweaver gives each Lurker two double-damage Cleave Spring attacks a fight; capped, but the burst needs a sim.
Mabyn, Reader of the Minutes and Tapwell stack permanent growth on every Lurker each turn once Patient is guaranteed; check it doesn't run far past the Tier 6 target.
Golden Master next to a golden Diadem repeats Spring effects six times; slots cap summons, but Tapwell's permanent Spring gain multiplies.
